title: Learn Canadian French with Nat
author: Learn Canadian French with Nat
description:
Hi, my name is Nat and welcome to my YouTube channel! 

I’m a bilingual native French and English speaker from Montreal, Quebec, Canada.

On this YouTube channel, I review pronunciation, vocabulary and grammar for Canadian French but I also enjoy discussing some of the interesting and quirky differences between Canadian French and Standard French.
